contract.goal: Buy every part of the MicroDuck power system V2 / battery backpack rev B that is not owned (Shawn 2026-11-20: "可以，加购物车"); cart only, no order.

chain.from: 2S 3000 mAh pack (XT30) and dock contact pads
chain.to: Pololu 2813 soft switch -> OpenRB J4 plug 3 and DFR1202, XIAO cutoff, 16 mm LED button

allowed_modifications.source: power-switch-20261119/README.md: XT30 pigtails soldered to the Pololu VIN/VOUT holes; XIAO harness soldered (approved concept rev B).

requirements.requirement: 2S LiPo about 3000 mAh, XT30 discharge plug, JST-XH 3-pin balance, at least 8 A continuous, fits the rev B box (72-74 x 34 x 19-20 mm).
Pololu Big Pushbutton Power Switch HP #2813 (4.5-32 V, ON/OFF pins), 2 units.

E-Switch PV6F240SS-331: 16 mm momentary SPST-NO, green LED ring (2.8 V 20 mA, 120 ohm from 5 V), body 20.0 mm to terminal tips; rev B CAD drawn around it (Adafruit 560 rejected: 35.3 mm deep does not fit the 28.55 mm box).
1/4 W through-hole 100 k x6 and 33 k x3 for the XIAO dividers and OFF pull-down.
Amass XT30 male and female with 16 AWG leads for pack-to-Pololu VIN and Pololu VOUT-to-plug 3.
20 AWG red/black silicone for pads-diode-Pololu and Pololu-DFR1202 runs.
26 AWG silicone, several colours, for the XIAO harness, button lead and OFF line.
JST B3B-XH-A 3-pin XH header for the balance plug on the XIAO harness
10 k 1/4 W for the ON line

candidates.primary: Amazon: B08LZ8L4YD; DigiKey: 2183-2813-ND x1 (+1 spare), EG4731-ND, CF14JT100KCT-ND x10, CF14JT33K0CT-ND x10, CF14JT10K0CT-ND x10, 455-2248-ND x2; RoboClub stock (Shawn 2026-11-20): XT30 plugs, 16/20/26 AWG silicone wire
candidates.chain: pack XT30 -> pigtail -> Pololu 2813 -> plug 3 / DFR1202; XIAO dividers; button to ON
